requirements.text: Contract Type: W2 (USC and GC Only)
Deep expertise in Windchill customization and configuration.
Proven experience integrating Windchill with enterprise applications.

We are seeking a seasoned professional to lead the design, development, and implementation of complex enterprise PLM solutions utilizing the PTC Windchill platform. This role demands extensive expertise in customizing, configuring, integrating, and architecting Windchill to deliver robust and scalable solutions. The ideal candidate will collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into effective technical designs and provide technical guidance to the development team.
